card.name: Administration and infusion instructions text
card.fires_on: Scattered words and digits inside dosing and administration instructions, such as syringe strengths, infusion steps, and time limits like within 24 hours. No single word type fits all cases.

modes.label: Timing words in instructions
modes.description: Linking words about when to infuse, observe or monitor.
modes.example: the admixture should be infused<< within>> 24 hours.

modes.label: Digits inside strengths and rates
modes.description: A digit partway through a syringe strength, dose, or rate table number.

modes.label: Steps before or during injection
modes.description: Verbs or small words in how-to-administer steps.
modes.example: securely attached before<< beginning>> the injection.

card.plain: It fires on small words and digits in step-by-step instructions for giving injections and infusions.
